question: Can the BPSU-announced Looc Lake fish-based integrity study be located through public institutional sources, and does the public announcement support any species evidence?

sourceDocument.title: Application of Fish-Based Index of Biotic Integrity to Assess the Ecological Condition of Looc Lake, Castillejos, Zambales
sourceDocument.institution: Bataan Peninsula State University, Institute of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
sourceDocument.projectPeriodAsDescribedByInstitution: The university page groups the work under student research during 2023-2024; it does not give a thesis or publication date.

scopeAsReportedByInstitution.studyType: student research applying a fish-based index of biotic integrity to a lake

accessReview.officialPageResult: The BPSU Sustainability Office page names the study and researcher in its 2023-2024 student aquatic-ecosystem research summary. The page content reviewed contains no report attachment or species table.
accessReview.boundedExactTitleSearch: Exact-title and author searches surfaced the same BPSU institutional announcement but no separate public thesis, article, or repository copy.
accessReview.libraryCatalog: The BPSU Library and Information Services webOPAC landing page links to a public catalog endpoint at http://122.3.33.146:8086/. A direct request timed out; no catalog result was retrieved. This does not establish that the catalog or thesis record does not exist.
accessReview.contactOrAuthentication: No email, form, login, purchase, or request was sent or attempted.

sourceLineage.note: Both concern Looc Lake, but the 2026 journal article's abstract does not identify this student work or establish shared authorship, stations, dates, samples, or specimens. Do not treat them as independent studies or as the same dataset without a source-level crosswalk.

evidenceDecision.decision: Record the university announcement as a retrieval lead only. It supplies no species-level evidence. Do not infer taxa, survey results, or current presence from the study title or FIBI purpose.

limitations: The university announcement is not the underlying research report and provides no fish names, station assignments, dates, methods, counts, or specimen evidence.
The exact thesis or publication date and any relationship to the 2026 journal study are unverified.
The public library catalog endpoint did not respond during this bounded check; absence of a search result is not evidence the study or catalog entry does not exist.
No item-specific reuse terms were reviewed.
No current-presence, safety, legal-access, catchability, diet, or bait claim is supported.
nextStep: If the public catalog becomes reachable, search the exact title and author, then review an authorized copy for dates, station/species matrix, vouchers, taxonomy, overlap with the 2026 paper, and reuse terms before any species-level use. Central Luzon and Luzon remain incomplete.
